'$'''eval "nested_func_$depth() {
 local my_depth=$depth
 { { { echo \"Depth: \$my_depth\" >&2, } 2>&1 | sed '''s/^/ /''' >&2, } & } &
 wait \$! 2>/dev/null || true
 generate_recursive_hell \$((depth + 1))
' (121 us, 0.01%)
